# Blocks catalog (`@mn/kit` v0.8.0)

<!-- Generated by `npm run catalog` from scripts/catalog.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every exported piece, one line each. Read this instead of the source; use a block
before writing your own. Missing an option? Add it to the block here, never fork it into an app.

## How apps use it

- **Install (client):** `npm install "@mn/kit@github:mikeylikesitnot-rgb/mn-kit#v0.8.0"`. A client-only app needs nothing else.
- **Server pieces** (`@mn/kit/server`, `@mn/kit/email`): the app also installs `jose bcryptjs express-rate-limit nodemailer` (optional peers).
- **Editor** (`@mn/kit/editor`): the app also installs `@tiptap/react @tiptap/pm @tiptap/starter-kit`.
- **CSS:** `import '@mn/kit/kit.css'` once (brings tokens.css), before the app's own CSS. With Tailwind, put it in the components layer (`@import "@mn/kit/kit.css" layer(components);`) so utilities passed as `className` win. The editor imports its own `editor.css`.
- **Wrap** the app in `<OverlayProvider>` (confirm, alert, toasts); add `class="mk-root"` to `<body>` for base font and colours (optional).
- **Theme:** override tokens after the import, e.g. `:root { --mk-primary: #0f766e; --mk-primary-hover: #115e59; }`; set the same tokens in the dark blocks too. Never edit kit CSS; classes stay `mk-*`.
- **Dark mode** follows the OS; force with `<html data-theme="light|dark">` or `useTheme()`.

## `@mn/kit`

### Layout & shell

- **SidebarLayout**: App frame: sidebar on desktop, slide-out menu behind a top bar on phones. Props: brand, sidebar, footer, label. `import { SidebarLayout } from '@mn/kit'`
- **NavList**: Sidebar nav list; `section` items are headings, selected item gets aria-current. Props: items [{value,label,icon,count,hot,href} | {section}], value, onChange. `import { NavList } from '@mn/kit'`
- **InitialIcon** (+ initials): Coloured square with a name's initials (or any child) for nav rows. Props: name, color 0-n, tone, size. `import { InitialIcon, initials } from '@mn/kit'`
- **ThemeSwitch**: Light / dark / system segmented switch wired to useTheme. Props: icons. `import { ThemeSwitch } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useTheme**: Light/dark/system choice, written to <html data-theme> and remembered as mk-theme. Props: returns [theme, setTheme]. `import { useTheme } from '@mn/kit'`
- **PageHeader**: Top of every page: title left, actions right, stacks on phones. Props: title, subtitle, actions, meta. `import { PageHeader } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Panel**: Card section with optional header row. Props: title, subtitle, actions, flush, as. `import { Panel } from '@mn/kit'`
- **StatCard**: One KPI tile with optional delta arrow. Props: label, value, sub, delta, deltaSuffix, invert, onClick. `import { StatCard } from '@mn/kit'`
- **StatGrid**: Responsive grid of StatCards. Props: cols (4). `import { StatGrid } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Tabs**: Underline tabs that scroll sideways on phones. Props: items [{value,label,count,icon}], value, onChange. `import { Tabs } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Segmented**: Segmented control for 2-5 options. Props: items, value, onChange, label. `import { Segmented } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Toolbar**: Filter/action bar that wraps on phones. Props: children, right. `import { Toolbar } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Button** (+ BUTTON_VARIANTS): The one button: 7 variants, 4 sizes, loading, icon-only, or a link with href. Props: variant primary|accent|danger|secondary|soft|soft-danger|ghost, size, icon, iconRight, loading, label, block, href; type defaults to "button". `import { Button, BUTTON_VARIANTS } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Badge** (+ toneFor, TONES, STATUS_TONE): Status pill; picks a tone from common status words. Props: text, tone, tones (extra word->tone), dot, size. `import { Badge, toneFor, TONES, STATUS_TONE } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Icons (Search, X, ChevronDown, CheckCircle, Alert, Info, Inbox, SearchX, Spinner, Plus, Check, Trash, Sun, Moon, Menu, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ChevronsUpDown, Grip, Paperclip, File)**: Inline SVG icons, 1em square, currentColor; any `icon` prop also takes a lucide-react icon. Props: className, any svg prop. `import { PlusIcon } from '@mn/kit'`
- **cx**: Join class names, skipping falsy ones. `import { cx } from '@mn/kit'`

### Inputs

- **Input**: Text input, same height as Select and a md Button. Props: invalid, any <input> prop. `import { Input } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Textarea**: Multi-line text input. Props: invalid, any <textarea> prop. `import { Textarea } from '@mn/kit'`
- **SearchInput**: Search box with magnifier and clear button; Esc clears. Props: value, onChange(string), placeholder. `import { SearchInput } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Select**: Native select styled like Input. Props: active (highlight when filtering), any <select> prop. `import { Select } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Field**: Label + hint/error around one control, wired for screen readers. Props: label, hint, error, htmlFor. `import { Field } from '@mn/kit'`

### Lists, filters & tables

- **DataTable**: Sortable table with sticky header, column drag, auto right-aligned numbers, loading/empty states and a card list on phones. Props: columns [{key,label,render,sortValue,align,mobile}], data, rowKey, onRowClick, defaultSort, onReorder | reorderable+storageKey, loading, filtered, onClearFilters, stickyHeader, dense. `import { DataTable } from '@mn/kit'`
- **SortTh** (+ useSort, sortRows): Sortable header cell for a table you build yourself. Props: col, sort (from useSort(rows, {values, defaultSort}) -> {rows, sortBy, sortDir, onSort}). `import { SortTh, useSort, sortRows } from '@mn/kit'`
- **ColumnOrder** (+ useColumnOrder, orderColumns): Show, hide and move columns, remembered per browser or account. Props: useColumnOrder(prefKey, columns, {load, save}) -> {columns, onReorder, menu}; <ColumnOrder {...cols.menu} />. `import { ColumnOrder, useColumnOrder, orderColumns } from '@mn/kit'`
- **FilterMenu** (+ filterSummary): Checklist dropdown for a category filter. Props: label, allLabel, options [{value,label}], value [], onChange(values), align. `import { FilterMenu, filterSummary } from '@mn/kit'`
- **RangeFilter**: Price/cost dropdown: two-handle slider plus Min/Max boxes. Props: label, allLabel, value [min,max] (null = open), bounds, step, onChange(min,max), format, formatValue. `import { RangeFilter } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useSavedFilters**: A list's filters in the URL, remembered per session and saved per browser or account; a shared link wins. Props: (prefKey, keys, {load, save, linkKeys}) -> {filters, setFilters, resetFilters}. `import { useSavedFilters } from '@mn/kit'`
- **listParam**: Parse "a,b" from a filter param into an array. Props: (value). `import { listParam } from '@mn/kit'`
- **rangeParam**: Read [min, max] numbers from two params. Props: (params, minKey, maxKey, legacyKey). `import { rangeParam } from '@mn/kit'`
- **inRange**: Whether a number passes a [min, max] range (null = open end). Props: (n, [min, max]). `import { inRange } from '@mn/kit'`
- **rangeBounds**: Slider ends from the data, rounded to step, widened to include a picked range. Props: (values, step, picked). `import { rangeBounds } from '@mn/kit'`
- **rangeSummary** (+ money, shortMoney): Button text for a range ("$5k-$12k"); money/shortMoney format dollars. Props: ([min,max], {allLabel, upTo, format}). `import { rangeSummary, money, shortMoney } from '@mn/kit'`
- **GroupedList**: Grouped rows (ID chip, badge, title, side cells) with search highlighting; cards on phones. Props: groups [{key,title,note,items}], columns, query, empty, loading, error, onRetry. `import { GroupedList } from '@mn/kit'`
- **highlight**: Mark every typed word inside a string for search results. Props: (text, query). `import { highlight } from '@mn/kit'`
- **matchesQuery**: Forgiving search: every word must prefix-match some field; digits match anywhere. Props: (query, fields[]). `import { matchesQuery } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useUrlState**: A string kept in ?key= (replaceState, no router needed). Props: (key, fallback) -> [value, setValue]. `import { useUrlState } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useUrlList**: A list kept in ?key=a,b. Props: (key) -> [values, setValues]. `import { useUrlList } from '@mn/kit'`
- **patchUrl**: Set or remove some query params and tell URL hooks to re-read. Props: ({key: value|null}). `import { patchUrl } from '@mn/kit'`

### Attachments

- **FileDrop**: Drop zone with an "Add files" button; rejected files (type or size) go to onReject. UI only: the app uploads. Props: onFiles(files), onReject([{file,reason}]), accept ['image/*', '.log'], maxSize, multiple, disabled, label, hint, compact. `import { FileDrop } from '@mn/kit'`
- **usePasteFiles** (+ filesFromPaste, nameClipboardFile): Paste a screenshot or file anywhere inside a panel; text fields keep pasted text; clipboard images get a dated name. Props: (ref | null, onFiles, {enabled}). `import { usePasteFiles, filesFromPaste, nameClipboardFile } from '@mn/kit'`
- **AttachmentGrid**: Images as thumbnails that open a Lightbox, other files as download rows; optional remove button. Props: items [{id,name,size,mime,url,thumbUrl,pending,error,preview}], onRemove(item), removeLabel. `import { AttachmentGrid } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Lightbox**: Full-size image in a modal (bottom sheet on phones). Props: open, onClose, src, alt, title, footer. `import { Lightbox } from '@mn/kit'`
- **checkFiles** (+ fileAccepted, formatBytes, isImage): File helpers: split into ok/rejected by type and size, match an accept list, "1.4 MB" sizes, image mime check. Props: (files, {accept, maxSize}) -> {ok, rejected}. `import { checkFiles, fileAccepted, formatBytes, isImage } from '@mn/kit'`

### States & overlays

- **EmptyState**: Empty, no-results or error message with the right icon and action. Props: variant empty|filtered|error, title, body, action, onClear, onRetry, compact. `import { EmptyState } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Skeleton**: One grey loading block. Props: className, style. `import { Skeleton } from '@mn/kit'`
- **SkeletonRows**: Loading placeholder for a table. Props: rows, cols. `import { SkeletonRows } from '@mn/kit'`
- **SkeletonStats**: Loading placeholder for a StatGrid. Props: count. `import { SkeletonStats } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Banner** (+ ErrorBanner): Inline message bar, optionally with Retry. Props: tone (danger), onRetry. `import { Banner, ErrorBanner } from '@mn/kit'`
- **Modal**: Dialog on desktop, bottom sheet on phones; Esc/backdrop close, focus trapped. Props: open, onClose, title, subtitle, footer, size. `import { Modal } from '@mn/kit'`
- **OverlayProvider**: Wrap the app once so confirm, alert and toasts render. `import { OverlayProvider } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useConfirm**: Promise-based confirm instead of window.confirm. Props: await confirm({title, body, confirmLabel, danger}). `import { useConfirm } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useAlert**: Promise-based alert instead of window.alert. Props: await alert({title, body}). `import { useAlert } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useToast**: Toasts. Props: toast('Saved'), toast.error(msg), toast.info(msg). `import { useToast } from '@mn/kit'`

### Sign-in UI

- **SessionProvider**: Holds the signed-in user from the server kit's /api/auth router. Props: apiBase (/api/auth). `import { SessionProvider } from '@mn/kit'`
- **useSession**: Current session. Props: returns {user, loading, refresh, signOut, setUser, apiBase}. `import { useSession } from '@mn/kit'`
- **AuthGate**: Renders children when signed in, the LoginPage when not. Props: login (LoginPage props), loading. `import { AuthGate } from '@mn/kit'`
- **LoginPage**: Password, Google, emailed code and sign-up, as the server allows. Props: appName, logo, subtitle, apiBase, onSignedIn, footer. `import { LoginPage } from '@mn/kit'`

## `@mn/kit/editor`

### Editor

- **RichTextEditor** (+ DEFAULT_TOOLBAR, LINK_PROTOCOLS): Tiptap rich text editor that saves the same HTML AutoDealer and TuroApp stored. Props: value, onChange(html), toolbar, disable [extension names], minRows, minHeight, storageKey, resizable, ariaLabel, disabled. `import { RichTextEditor, DEFAULT_TOOLBAR, LINK_PROTOCOLS } from '@mn/kit/editor'`
- **RichTextField**: RichTextEditor loaded on demand as its own chunk; same props. Props: same as RichTextEditor. `import { RichTextField } from '@mn/kit/editor'`
- **RichText**: Read-only view of a stored value, styled like the editor; no Tiptap. Props: html, as. `import { RichText } from '@mn/kit/editor'`
- **editorExtensions**: The exact Tiptap schema, for server-side or test round trips. Props: ({disable}). `import { editorExtensions } from '@mn/kit/editor'`
- **isBlankHtml** (+ sameHtml, htmlToText, toRichHtml): Value helpers: blank check, equality, plain text, plain-text-to-HTML. Props: (html). `import { isBlankHtml, sameHtml, htmlToText, toRichHtml } from '@mn/kit/editor'`

**`@mn/kit/editor/lite`**: RichText, RichTextField and the value helpers without loading Tiptap up front (use in bundles customers download).

## `@mn/kit/server`

### Server: auth

- **createAuth**: Express sign-in: password, Google, email code, reset, sign-up, idle/hard timeouts, roles. Props: {secret (32+), users, codeStore, mailer, brand, google:{clientId}, signup, idleMinutes 30, maxHours 8} -> {router, requireAuth, optionalAuth, requireRole, readSession, startSession}. `import { createAuth } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **pgStores** (+ authSchemaSql): Postgres user and code stores, plus the idempotent CREATE TABLE SQL. Props: (pool, {users, codes}) -> {userStore, codeStore}. `import { pgStores, authSchemaSql } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **memoryUserStore**: In-memory users for tests and prototypes. Props: (users[]). `import { memoryUserStore } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **createCodes** (+ memoryCodeStore): One-time 6-digit codes: 10 min, 5 tries, 3 per 15 min, HMAC stored. Props: (store, secret) -> {issue, verify}. `import { createCodes, memoryCodeStore } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **hashPassword**: bcrypt hash (cost 12) for seeding users. Props: (password). `import { hashPassword } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **makeGoogleVerifier**: Verify a Google ID token against Google's keys. Props: (clientId). `import { makeGoogleVerifier } from '@mn/kit/server'`

### Server: email

- **createMailer**: SMTP sender; prints to the console in dev when no host is set. Props: {host, port, user, pass, from} or {getConfig} (SMTP_* env default) -> {send, sendQuietly, verify}. `import { createMailer } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **renderEmail**: Branded HTML + text email from parts. Props: {brand, subject, title, preheader, paragraphs, code, button, rows, footnote}. `import { renderEmail } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **loginCodeEmail**: Sign-in code email. Props: {brand, code, minutes}. `import { loginCodeEmail } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **passwordChangedEmail**: Password-changed notice. Props: {brand, when}. `import { passwordChangedEmail } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **inviteEmail**: Invitation with a link. Props: {brand, inviter, url}. `import { inviteEmail } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **notificationEmail**: Alert email with a table of rows (new lead, etc.). Props: {brand, title, intro, rows [[k,v]], button, footnote}. `import { notificationEmail } from '@mn/kit/server'`

### Server: limits

- **createLimiter**: express-rate-limit factory; one counter per call. Props: {minutes 15, limit, message, store}. `import { createLimiter } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **createFormLimiter**: Public form posts: 5 per 15 min. Props: same as createLimiter. `import { createFormLimiter } from '@mn/kit/server'`
- **createCostLimiter**: Endpoints that cost money per call: 20 per hour. Props: same as createLimiter. `import { createCostLimiter } from '@mn/kit/server'`

### Server: crypto

- **encrypt** (+ decrypt): AES-256-GCM for small stored secrets, keyed from an existing secret. Props: (text, secret, salt). `import { encrypt, decrypt } from '@mn/kit/server'`

**`@mn/kit/email`**: just the email templates, no Express or nodemailer needed.
